YS Falls Jamaica by rental car: how to get there, what to do nearby and how to book.

Waterfall days start with the keys. ✨

YS Falls is a south coast favourite. Pack a towel.

Rent a car and go see it for yourself.

Swim in cool pools below tiered falls and play on the rope swings.

Getting there: It is in St Elizabeth. Pick up at MBJ and allow about 2 hours going south.

Drive through Bamboo Avenue and finish with fresh fish on the south coast.
